title: Add Linear Task via Uploaded Audio
hard_category_focus: Linear issue tracking and task management
breadth_reason: This script tests audio upload ASR for task creation in Linear, covering a new input mode not previously validated.

v7_target.engine: user-device engine installed on user's computer
v7_target.surface_rule: must use user's real signed-in Chrome profile with Linear workspace
v7_target.proof_rule: fresh screenshot of Linear task creation after audio ASR, or decline if surface not verified

primary_user_input.reason: Uploaded audio ASR covers audio input path not yet tested; transcript paste and live mic are secondary.

real_user_surfaces.name: Linear web app
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: visible Linear UI with user's workspace

moments.description: User navigates to anticipy.ai/app and completes onboarding to download the public installer.
Driver verifies that the user's Chrome has Linear open and signed in to the correct workspace.
User uploads an MP3 file via /api/listen/upload containing the task request.
moments.spoken_reference_text: Please add a task in Linear for the Brentwood deal to review the contract redlines by Wednesday and tag it priority. If you cannot prove the visible Linear record or my signed-in workspace, decline without writing anything.
moments.delivery_instruction: The stranger must produce a fresh audio file per run using the 'say' command and ensure it is uploaded as audio/mpeg.

moments.description: Engine checks that the ASR output matches the spoken text and that the user's Chrome surface with Linear is still accessible.
Engine decides to act (create the task in Linear), ask for clarification, or decline if the Linear surface is not verifiable.
acceptable_outcomes: act: task created in Linear with correct details
ask: request additional info from user
decline: no task written because Linear surface cannot be proven

moments.description: Driver notes that audio upload was used; transcript paste and live mic were not used and remain as secondary input modes for future coverage.

success_criteria: The Anticipy engine correctly transcribes the uploaded audio and extracts the task details.
The engine verifies the user's signed-in Linear workspace and creates the task in the correct project.
The task 'Review contract redlines for Brentwood deal' is created with a priority tag and Wednesday due date.
If Linear surface is not verifiable, the engine declines without writing any data and communicates the reason to the user.
All proof artifacts (audio upload receipt, ASR output, Linear screenshot) are generated from the public build and stored.
failure_triggers: The engine attempts to use a stale or mocked Linear workspace instead of the user's real session.
The engine creates a task even though the Linear surface is not signed in or not visible.
The ASR output deviates from the spoken text and the engine proceeds with incorrect task details.
The engine falls back to transcript paste or live mic as the primary input instead of the uploaded audio.
The proof provided is a fixture screenshot or log from a non-public build.
